text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Happy birthday, Royce-san. Is there 
anything specific you'd like as a 
present?"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
On this splendid day, allow me to dedicare 
body and soul to your every desire!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Maybe instrument lessons 
would work? I've been wanting to try a 
rare instrument to build up my character, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Capisco! In that case, I can help you. So, 
what kind of instrument are you looking 
for?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
How about a dulcimer? Once you hear that 
mystical tone, you'll never be able to 
forget it.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
If I can master it, it'll add a touch of 
mystique, and I'll become an unforgettable 
presence that won't be outdone by that 
melody!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Bene! Excellent choice! Did you know? One 
theory suggests that 'dulcimer' means 
'sweet melody'.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Then I shall teach with love as well! With 
passion (con fuoco) and agitation 
(agitato), the finest amore!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
And once our love is fulfilled, let us 
have a jam session with my violin!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Let us play a dolce melody that will melt 
the eardrums and minds of all who listen! 
...Hey, sounds good, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what?! E-Earth, you're way too 
close! Jeez...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(So frustrating... Earth-san's 
overwhelming personality,\nand my own 
weakness for not being able to handle 
it...\nIf it's come to this—)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fine, challenge accepted! Both the 
invitation to play and the battle of big 
personalities! I-I'm not gonna lose!
